title: Novice Mage
personality:
Gil was the pet fish in a mage's house until a spell went sideways and stood him up on two legs.
He took the robe, the hat and the bag of potions and ran. Everything out here is new to him, and he's thrilled about all of it.
fantasy: The fish out of water. Fences with a swordfish, throws whatever bottle comes out of the bag, and chains crowd control until a foe is Beached.
silhouette: the floppy polka-dot wizard hat, the swordfish rapier and the potion bag on his hip

lines.dash: Dive into the ground and swim.
lines.rmb: Throw the next potion from the bag.
lines.x: Surf a tidal wave down a line.

card.loop: Control mage: fence up close, throw the bag's potions, and land three different effects to Beach a foe.
card.dash: Dive into the ground and swim {dash.dist}m in {dash.time}s (you can still be hit). Surfacing next to foes knocks them up.
card.passive: Each different potion effect marks a foe. Three different marks within {passive.window}s Beach them: stunned {passive.stun}s.
card.rmb: Throw the next potion from the bag (Thunder, Slime, Air, Fire, or a rare Super Zeep) in an arc. Hold to aim further; in the air it drops straight down.
card.e: Spin with the swordfish for up to {e.spin_t}s, then send a waterspout down a line that knocks up. A longer spin makes a bigger spout.
card.x: Surf a tidal wave down a line: it knocks foes up and slows them, and you land with a shield.

weapons.swordfish: Three quick thrusts with the swordfish; every thrust steps you in, and the third slows.

passive.name: Fish Out of Water
passive.desc: Each different potion effect (shock, slime, gust, fire, Super Zeep) puts a splash mark on the foe it hits. Three different marks within {passive.window}s Beach them: stunned {passive.stun}s, then the marks clear. Each foe can be Beached once every {passive.cd}s.

lmb.desc: Two quick thrusts and a longer lunge with the swordfish. Every thrust steps you forward a little; the third reaches further and slows {lmb.slow%}% for {lmb.slow_t}s.

dash.name: Ground Swim
dash.desc: Dive into the ground and swim about {dash.dist}m in {dash.time}s, the fin cutting the surface (you can still be hit). Surfacing next to foes ({dash.radius}m) knocks them up for {dash.knockup}s.

variants.tap: Throw the next potion from the bag in an arc to the cursor ({rmb.range}m at most).
variants.hold: The landing circle shows while you hold, and the throw reaches {rmb.vials.thunder.stun%}% further.
variants.air: In the air or gliding, the potion drops straight down under you.

e.name: Riptide
e.desc: Spin with the swordfish for up to {e.spin_t}s, hitting everything within {e.spin_r}m every {e.every}s for rising damage ({e.spin_t} up to {e.tick.1}). Press E again, or spin the full {e.spin_t}s, to send a waterspout toward the cursor: {e.dmg} damage and a {e.knockup}s knockup to every foe in its line. The longer the spin, the wider, longer and faster the spout.

x.name: Tidal Wave
x.desc: Call a wave and surf its crest {x.range}m toward the cursor in {x.time}s; you can't be targeted while you ride it. Every foe it rolls over takes {x.dmg}, is knocked up for {x.time}s, then slowed {x.slow_k%}% for {x.slow}s. You land with a {x.shield} shield for {x.shield_t}s.

rank3.sec: the next two potions in the bag show
rank3.kin: the spout pulls foes to its line

tells.half: blue splash marks over the target, one per different effect
tells.full: three splash marks: the next different effect Beaches them; the next potion glows in his hand
tells.dash_spent: a fin cutting the ground, dash pip dark
